paper_id: iReDev_ A Knowledge-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Requirements Development
title: iReDev: A Knowledge-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Requirements Development
motivation: Requirements development is time-consuming and labor-intensive, yet existing LLM multi-agent systems provide limited support for this critical phase.
problem_framing: Current multi-agent frameworks ignore expert knowledge injection, lack dynamic collaboration mechanisms, and overlook human-agent collaboration in requirements engineering.
key_insight: Injecting structured expert knowledge (methodologies, standards, heuristics) into agents via chain-of-thought enables them to simulate real requirements engineers and produce higher-quality artifacts.
method_signature: Six knowledge-driven agents with event-driven artifact pool and human-in-the-loop.
evaluation_criteria: BLEU, BertScore, G-Eval completeness/correctness/cohesion on user requirements lists, use case models, and SRS documents.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Current framework depends on manually extracting knowledge; knowledge is treated as static asset, not automatically evolved.
evidence_for_taste: LLMs tend not to achieve satisfactory performance
lack a reasoning process, resulting in unsatisfactory performance
existing works only assign agents as roles, without considering
The monitoring scope for each agent can be customized
The knowledge can be parsed and extracted manually or using NLP
thinking_moves: 将需求开发重新定义为多智能体协作系统，而非单一LLM任务
从权威文献和专家经验中提取结构化知识，而非仅依赖LLM内部知识
采用黑板机制的事件驱动通信，支持需求迭代和反馈循环
将人类知识作为智能体设计核心，而非事后追加
通过多种指标组合评估，而非单一自动化指标
